root_causes.evidence: [E1] payments config by ops-maintenance 12 s ago changed max_transfer_minor from 1000000 to 1, and the payments log shows repeated 'amount exceeds transfer limit ... limit_minor=1' rejections starting 11 s ago.

[C2] clearing exited 1 time(s) with a JSONDecodeError while parsing item 91, and [B1] shows item 91 at the head of the queue with 0 attempts, so the same unreadable item crashes the worker each time it is read.

B3 shows screening p95 1819 ms against a 15 ms baseline, and payments logged 'fraud screening timeout via primary' with timeout_s=1.0 on every recent attempt, matching D3 and D4. Screening-standby was stopped and started several times (E2-E7) and is on release 4.1 with no reported fault, so it is the healthy path to fail over to. Gateway's failures (A1, D1) and latency (B1, D2) are carried through payments from this slow dependency.

sbar.situation: Recovery is confirmed: the last recovery check at 63 s was clean, two looks in a row. Payments now runs with its transfer limit restored and screening served by its standby.
sbar.background: Ops-maintenance changed payments max_transfer_minor from 1000000 to 1 about 12 s before the failures began, and payments began rejecting transfers over that limit 11 s later. Screening's primary path was also slow, with p95 at 1819 ms against a 15 ms baseline, which made payments time out. Clearing exited repeatedly on an unreadable queue item 91 with a JSONDecodeError.
sbar.assessment: Three root causes were found: bad_config on payments (confidence 0.95), poison_message on clearing (confidence 0.9), and dependency_slow on screening (confidence 0.85). The gateway's failures and latency came from the payments and screening faults, not from a separate gateway fault. The incident commander took these actions itself: reverted payments max_transfer_minor to 1000000, quarantined item 91 from clearing, restarted clearing, and failed screening over to its standby, which is on release 4.1 and showed no fault.
sbar.recommendation: Escalate to the operations team soon: review item 91 set aside from clearing, then either repair and resubmit it or close it with its customer. Confirm with the operations team any money or data effects from the rejected and delayed transfers during the window. Investigate why the primary screening path is slow before failing back to it.
